name: Command palette
tagline: Cmd+K over commands, repos, PRs and issues
summary: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens one search field over commands, your repositories, pull requests and issues. Typing two or more characters also searches GitHub for items you are involved in.

flow.label: useCommandPalette
flow.note: Cmd/Ctrl+K toggles the overlay; the same hook wires the G-key shortcuts from the registry.

flow.label: CommandPalette
flow.note: Holds the query, the kind filter and the selected row; matches local items on every typed word.

flow.label: useCommandItems
flow.note: Builds rows from commands and from repos, pulls and issues already in the query cache.

flow.label: searchCommandPaletteGitHub
flow.note: After 250 ms and 2+ characters, searches pull requests and issues that involve the viewer.

flow.label: GitHub search API
flow.note: Two REST issue searches with 'involves:<login> archived:false', 5 results each, newest first.

flow.label: PalettePreview
flow.note: A card beside the list shows the selected item; details load once the selection rests 140 ms.

features.name: Commands and key sequences
features.summary: A registry of commands with optional sequences such as G then P, or G then G to open the page on GitHub. Page links work by key only, not as rows.

entry.role: Adds commands; the built-in ones follow below it
Open state plus the global shortcuts

features.name: Search over cached items
features.summary: Repositories, pull requests and issues already loaded for the lists can be found at once, with no request.

entry.role: Turns cached query data into palette rows

features.name: Live GitHub search
features.summary: Server search for pull requests and issues involving you. Results are filtered by App access and added to the cached lists.

entry.role: Server function that runs the two searches
Merges found items into the 'mine' list caches

features.name: Filter by kind
features.summary: Chips with counts narrow results to one group. Tab, Shift+Tab and the left and right arrows cycle them; Backspace on an empty field clears.

entry.role: Result count and the kind chips

features.name: Preview card
features.summary: On wide windows a card to the left follows the selected row and shows the pull request, issue or repository at a glance.

entry.role: The card and its three variants

features.name: Context commands
features.summary: Create actions, Switch repository, Pin or Unpin, Refresh data and, inside a repository, links to Commits, Branches, Tags and Releases.

entry.role: Drops the IndexedDB cache and refetches

features.name: Repository code search
features.summary: /owner/repo/search runs GitHub code search scoped to that repository and also lists matching file paths from the loaded file tree.

entry.role: Fuzzy path matcher shared with the file finder

entryPoints.role: The dialog: input, kind bar, rows, footer hints
Everything the palette can show before a server search
Command registry and the built-in commands
Server side of the live search
Opens and closes the palette from anywhere
Shortcut hook the palette registers its keys with

goodParts: Cached rows and GitHub results are de-duplicated by where they open, so an item never shows twice (matchItems, command-palette.tsx:494).
The preview fetches details only after the selection rests 140 ms, so arrowing through rows makes no requests (palette-preview.tsx:41).
watch: No tests: lib/command-palette has no test files and no e2e spec opens the palette.
command-palette.tsx (540 lines) defines its own useMediaQuery and useDebouncedValue although lib/use-media-query.ts and lib/use-debounced-value.ts exist.
The pull request and issue row builders are written twice in use-command-items.ts (useCommandItems at :57, getCommandSearchItems at :215).
